section.title: Overview
section.para: The ndb_tarantool module provides a high-performance, non-blocking connector for Tarantool In-Memory Computing Platform and Database. It connects Kamailio SIP workers directly to Tarantool 3.x using the native binary IProto protocol.

Key features include:
Native IProto 3.x Protocol with MessagePack serialization via libmsgpack-c.
Per-worker socket lifecycle management using Kamailio child_init hooks.
Strict memory management with pkg_malloc and shm_malloc.
Greeting handshake and SHA-1 scramble authentication.
Rich KEMI bindings for Lua, Python, and native Kamailio routing scripts.

section.title: &kamailio; Modules
section.para:
The following modules must be loaded before this module:
none.

section.title: External Libraries or Applications
section.para:
The following libraries must be installed on the system:
libmsgpack-c / libmsgpack-dev - MessagePack serialization library.

section.title: server (string)
section.para: Defines a Tarantool server connection. Can be specified multiple times for cluster/failover setups.

section.title: init_without_tarantool (integer)
section.para: If set to 1, Kamailio startup will not fail if Tarantool instances are temporarily unreachable.

section.title: cmd_timeout (integer)
section.para: Socket read/write command timeout in milliseconds.

section.title: disable_time (integer)
section.para: Duration in seconds to temporarily disable an unreachable Tarantool node before retrying.

section.title: allowed_timeouts (integer)
section.para: Number of consecutive command timeouts/errors before temporarily disabling the Tarantool node for disable_time seconds.
Executes a stored procedure (IPROTO_CALL) on the default Tarantool server.
Executes an arbitrary Lua expression (IPROTO_EVAL) on the default Tarantool server.
